note: No news feed on the desk. Links out to where news is published, plus two short briefs written by Claude from checked sources: brief = the last session(s) and what to look for today and tomorrow; week = what has happened this week (on a weekend: the week just gone) and what is ahead. Refreshed daily by the "desk-news-brief" scheduled task (scripts/news-brief.md); facts only, never a call.

summary: Weekend after Friday 20 Nov: S&P 500 closed at 6,910 (-3.7% on the day), below its 200-day average (7,349); Nasdaq Composite -5.3%; VIX 35.9. No Sunday futures report found yet.

Nvidia: Reuters reported SEC enforcement staff are examining possible accounting issues; the inquiry is described as early stage and no charges have been brought. The stock fell 14% on Friday to $125.53 and more than 20% on the week.
Friday close: US 10-year yield 4.91% (-14bp), gold -4.6% to 3,515, WTI 83.41, dollar index 103.81. Bitcoin, trading over the weekend, at 61,007 (+1.5% on the day).
FX on Friday: AUD weakest of the eight (-0.7% against the other seven), USD and EUR firmest (+0.3% and +0.2%); AUDJPY -0.6% to 106.30.
watch: Any further reporting or company statement on the SEC inquiry at Nvidia before the Asia open.
Mon 23 Nov: November flash PMIs for the US, euro area, Germany, France, UK, Japan and Australia; speakers include BoE Pill, ECB Lane and Fed Williams.
Tue 24 Nov: no major release confirmed; Wednesday carries the US and Australian data.

happened: Week of 16 Nov: S&P 500 -8.6% to 6,910, Nasdaq Composite -10.0%, VIX +16.6pt to 35.9.

Nvidia reported Q3 on Tue 17 Nov, then fell more than 20% on the week amid the reported SEC inquiry and turmoil after Jensen Huang left as CEO; the board has ruled out his return. The Anthropic IPO had a volatile debut and did not stop the selloff.
US 10-year yield 4.91% (-24bp), dollar index 103.81 (+0.4%), gold -9.5% to 3,515, WTI crude -5.8% to 83.41, Bitcoin -6.6% to 61,007.
FX on the week: JPY strongest (+1.1% against the other seven), USD next (+1.0%), AUD weakest (-1.6%); AUDJPY -2.3%.
ahead: Mon 23 Nov: November flash PMIs (US, euro area, Germany, France, UK, Japan, Australia).

Wed 25 Nov: US October PCE prices (headline and core) and the Q3 GDP second estimate (first estimate 3.4% annualised); Australian October CPI the same day, the last CPI before the RBA December meeting.
Thu 26 Nov: US markets shut for Thanksgiving. Fri 27 Nov: shortened US session, no major US data scheduled.
Central banks: no decision confirmed this week for the eight majors. RBNZ next Monetary Policy Statement is 9 Dec (RBNZ schedule). Exact release times: Market Context calendar.
